# Workspace instructions

- Build a production-oriented React + TypeScript + Vite chat frontend.
- Preserve the feature-oriented architecture and separation of UI, hooks, types, and mock/API services.
- Use strict TypeScript and avoid `any`.
- Keep UI components reusable and feature modules independently maintainable.
- Use mock data and mock service implementations only in this phase.
- Do not add real backend calls, authentication, databases, or WebSocket connections.
- Use Tailwind CSS, React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, and Axios.
- Use Vitest and React Testing Library for tests.
- Keep the Google Chat-style product identity and responsive desktop/tablet/mobile behavior.
